note: Test quality items. Each item states its population: the set of things the agent must enumerate, count and examine.

items.population: Every test reported in the suite output.
items.text: Ensure that every test in scope passes.

items.population: Every skipped, xfail, or disabled test reported in the suite output.
items.text: Ensure that every skipped or expected-failure test states a reason, and that the reason is still valid.

items.population: Every test file added or changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that tests are deterministic: no unseeded randomness, wall-clock time, live network, or dependence on test order.

items.population: Every test with a recorded duration in the suite output (use the runner's durations report if available).
items.text: Ensure that no test is unexpectedly slow relative to the rest of the suite.

items.population: Every public function, method, class, or behavior added or changed in production code in scope.
items.text: Ensure that each new or changed behavior has at least one test that exercises it.

items.population: Every production function added or changed in scope that accepts input.
items.text: Ensure that boundary conditions are tested (None/null, empty, zero, negative, maximum values, off-by-one).

items.population: Every error, exception, or failure path added or changed in production code in scope.
items.text: Ensure that each error path is exercised by a test that asserts the expected failure.

items.population: Every changed production line, using coverage data if the runner produced it.
items.text: Ensure that changed production lines are executed by the tests. If no coverage data exists, verdict n/a with that reason.

items.population: Every test added or changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that tests assert observable behavior, not only that mocks were called.

items.population: Every assertion in tests added or changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that assertions are specific (exact values, entire strings) rather than truthiness or partial matches.

items.population: Every production function added or changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that at least one test would fail if the production change were removed or inverted.

items.population: Every test added or changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that each test covers distinct behavior and does not repeat the code path or assertion of another test.

items.population: Every production file changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that production code was not removed or weakened to make tests pass.

items.population: Every test added or changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that tests do not share mutable state and pass when run individually or in any order.

items.population: Every test added or changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that tests exercise public behavior and do not test private members directly.

items.population: Every block of setup code repeated across two or more tests in scope.
items.text: Ensure that repeated setup is extracted into fixtures or helpers.

items.population: Every test added or changed in scope.
items.text: Ensure that test names describe the behavior being verified.
